author: ANN

title: MobSeka: Trapped in a Dating Sim Season 2 Reveals Second Visual, July 8 Premiere
content: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome is Tough for Mobs ( MobSeka ) Season 2 revealed the second key visual, along with a July 8 premiere date. Studio ENGI is returning to animate, with Kazura Miura back as the sole director (he co-directed Season 1 with Shinichi Fukumoto).
author: Anime Corner

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi Anime's Summer Debut, More Staff Listed
content: Anime Expo announced on Tuesday that Production I.G and Lucasfilm are hosting a special screening of the first episode of Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi , the limited anime series spinoff from the Star Wars: Visions project , on July 2.
author: ANN

title: FROGMAN's Anime Studio DLE Starts AI Brand Focused on Studio's Older IP
content: Animation studio DLE announced on Wednesday that it is launching a new brand called "AI Kaeru Otoko Shōkai" ("AI Frogman Company"), focused on making anime using generative AI based on the studio's older properties.

title: REDICE Studio's Overgeared Webtoon Gets Tempal TV Anime in October
content: South Korean webtoon studio REDICE Studio announced on Wednesday that its Overgeared webtoon is inspiring a television anime adaptation titled Tempal ~Item no Chikara~ (Tempal ~The Power of Items~). The anime will premiere in October. Yen Press publishes the webtoon in English under its Ize Press label.
author: ANN

title: Webtoon 'Overgeared' Gets TV Anime in Fall 2026
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Saenal Park and Team Argo 's Overgeared webtoon on Wednesday. The website also revealed the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Fired? But I Maintain All the Software!' Light Novels Get TV Anime
content: Publisher Shufu to Seikatsu Sha announced on Wednesday that Yuki Kashirome 's Fired? But I Maintain All the Software! ( E, Shanai System Subete Wanope Shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka? ) light novel series is inspiring a television anime adaptation . The announcement did not reveal any further details on the anime.
author: ANN

title: Overgeared Anime Announced, Reveals First Trailer, Visual, Staff, October 2026 Premiere
content: Overgeared anime adaptation was officially announced today, revealing the first teaser visual and trailer ahead of its October 2026 debut. The studio, main staff and cast were also revealed..
author: Anime Corner
